data.one_liner: Framework for writing Rust business logic with type-safe messaging in Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Rinf integrates Rust into Flutter applications as the native business logic layer. It automatically generates type-safe Dart classes from Rust structs and handles messaging between Dart and Rust through FFI.
use_when: You want to implement performance-critical business logic using Rust
You need cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web
You prefer an event-driven, stream-based approach for communication between GUI and backend
avoid_when: Your entire team only knows Dart and has no experience with Rust
You are building a simple app where native performance gains do not justify the build complexity
strengths: High-performance native execution via FFI without hidden web servers or webviews
Type-safe communication generated automatically from Rust structs
Supports all major Flutter platforms out of the box
weaknesses: Requires managing a Rust toolchain alongside Flutter
Project currently looking for a new maintainer
data.setup_notes: Requires installing Rust toolchain and configuring the build framework for native Rust compilation.
